subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the arena to fight the final round

20020201.text: Huh, why isn't he here yet...

20020202.text: #Never mind, we can start by making your entrance first, {NICKNAME}.

20020203.text: Everyone, listen up. Your attention, please!

20020204.text: We've reached the climax of The Crux Clash. This is the final match!

20020205.text: We've seen many exciting battles today, and now, at long last, the two finalists have emerged.

20020206.text: #Now, I'd like to introduce our first combatant. Though few have seen {F#her}{M#him}, {F#her}{M#his} reputation knows no bounds.

20020207.text: #{F#She}{M#He} strikes fear into the heart of Osial and the mere mention of {F#her}{M#his} name causes even Fatui Harbingers to turn pale in the face... Introducing Liyue's traveling hero, {NICKNAME}!

20020209.text: I've been waiting for this moment!

20020210.text: #I'm sure everyone witnessed {F#her}{M#his} thrilling match in the semi-finals.

20020211.text: But today's final round will surely take things up a notch!

20020212.text: As for our other combatant... Uh, he still hasn't arrived.

20020213.text: C'mon, what could be taking him so long? You can't just forfeit for not showing up like in previous rounds... This is the finals!

20020217.text: We've got no other choice... If he doesn't show up we'll just have to postpone the match.

20020218.text: Wait a moment. Something doesn't seem right about this.

20020219.text: Captain Beidou, perhaps we should check on the prize.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go check the box containing the Vision
Follow Kazuha to track down the Vision

20020402.text: It's gone alright... The Vision is missing.

20020403.text: Huh! Did somebody steal it? Who would dare do such a thing in broad daylight?

20020404.text: We don't know when it was taken exactly.

20020405.text: Huh! I never thought that someone here would have the guts to cross Captain Beidou.

20020406.text: No need to worry, even the craftiest sleight of hand does not escape nature's watchful gaze.

20020407.text: Hmm... The culprit has only acted recently. They will not have gotten far.

20020408.text: The Vision was the prize that I had offered, and it was my responsibility to look after it. I will be certain to get it back.

20020409.text: Well, if you insist. I'll leave the matter to you then.

20020410.text: I'll stay here and try to offer some explanation to all the spectators that came to see the match.

20020411.text: #If you would, please come with me, {NICKNAME}.

20020414.text: Umm, but we're on an island, where could he have possibly run to?

20020415.text: Come with me. I can sense the winds are coming.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the wind current location

20020101.text: Please make your way to the arena. Captain Beidou is waiting.

subQuests.subQuestName: Proceed to the small island ahead and search for clues
Defeat the Treasure Hoarders blocking the way
Talk to the Treasure Hoarder who stole the Vision

20020901.text: You caught up with me... How is that possible!?

20020902.text: I had even prepared a boat to ensure a quick getaway, and still, you caught up to me.

20020903.text: No boat could ever match the speed of the wind.

20020904.text: The wind? What are you talking about? Oh, I get it... your Vision!

20020905.text: Drat, if only I had a Vision... Or if I could activate this one, then you'd never be able to catch me!

20020906.text: This has nothing to do with Visions. You may be skilled at vanishing from a crowd, but it seems you know precious little about how to conceal yourself from nature's gaze.

20020907.text: Additionally, your chosen escape route was flawed for reasons that are too numerous to go into, and on top of that, I could hear your boasting and proud laughter in the wind as I was pursuing you.

20020908.text: In other words, you failed to meet any of the basic criteria for a grand heist: namely speed, stealth, and style.

20020910.text: But most disappointing of all is the state of the Vision in your hand.

20020911.text: It appears that the Vision doesn't respond to human desire indiscriminately.

20020913.text: I've had my eyes on this Vision for quite some time now. I decided to register after hearing that this fighting contest was full of a bunch of lousy fighters. I fought my way to the finals and...

20020914.text: Aha, so you were supposed to be our opponent!

20020915.text: I'd intended to win the contest through skill alone all along, but then you showed up!

20020916.text: After watching the semi-finals, I knew that I didn't stand a chance. But I wasn't about to give up on the Vision so easily after coming all this way.

20020917.text: Since there was no use in trying to face you in the match, I decided to put my skills to good use while everyone's attention was on you and Beidou.

20020918.text: I was convinced I'd prepared thoroughly for my escape... but somehow, you still managed to catch up to me.

20020920.text: Ugh... Drat... This could — this should have gone differently...

20020923.text: There'll be consequences if you resist any further.

20020924.text: Hah! I know an empty threat when I hear one!

20020928.text: Fine... but you'd better mean it! It didn't activate once I took it anyway, it's nothing but a useless shell to me.

20020929.text: You know, according to the laws of the sea, the penalty for stealing is breaking the culprit's arms...

20020930.text: Huh! You're not serious, are you!?

20020931.text: Not to mention that the item you stole was a prize, you didn't show up for the final match, and you damaged the reputation of the captain of The Crux Fleet.

20020932.text: It seems that it would be only fair to brand the word "thief" on your forehead with a hot iron.

20020933.text: Whoa, whoa, we don't need to go that far, do we?

20020934.text: Ugh, I never would have guessed you could be so cruel.

20020935.text: If this is where talking gets me, then forget it. I'll risk a fight!

20020922.text: After all I went through to get it? I think not!

20020925.text: Just do as we say and there'll be no further consequences.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the Treasure Hoarder again

20021102.text: No, no! Do what you want, but please, don't brand my forehead, please!!!

20021103.text: Hmm... He has persevered to the bitter end, and now death looms near... yet still, the gods do not bestow their favor upon him.

20021104.text: ...Put down the Vision and leave. I've changed my mind... No further punishment for you.

20021106.text: What's wrong? Are you asking for more punishment?

20021107.text: It's up to you. Such willingness is commendable and fits the way of the samurai.

20021108.text: N—No, no need for that. Thank you for releasing me. You truly are generous!

20021110.text: Huh, Paimon doesn't get it. Were you just trying to scare him?

20021111.text: I take no pleasure in frightening others. I was just testing all possibilities while the Vision remained in his hands.

20021112.text: When people are forced into a corner, that is when their greatest strength will appear. I thought it may be an opportunity for him to awaken the Vision.

20021114.text: So you were planning this all along?

20021115.text: Yes, I wanted to know whether it were possible for an extinguished Vision to be reawakened.

20021116.text: From the moment he stole the Vision, I decided to use him for this experiment.

20021117.text: I have tried many other methods in the past.

20021190.text: Though few tales tell of a "masterless Vision reawakening"...

20021191.text: After seeing you command multiple elements, I figured that nothing is impossible.

20021192.text: Come, why don't you give it a try? Let's see if you can give me the answer I'm hoping for.

20021120.text: Hmm, the Vision didn't seem to respond at all.

20021121.text: I see... So you are also unable to rekindle the Vision.

20021122.text: ...No matter, this was expected. I suppose this Vision is still mine to take for now.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the Guyun Stone Forest arena

20021201.text: Huh? Did Beidou leave already? Maybe she went back to her ship?

20021202.text: If you're looking for the Captain, she was summoned by Lady Ningguang.

20021203.text: It seems that The Crux Clash got out of hand this time and has attracted her attention.

20021204.text: Captain Beidou was muttering something about Ningguang being a stick-in-the-mud as she headed off to Liyue Harbor.

20021205.text: Haha, it's not unusual for those two to be at odds with one another.

20021206.text: But still, Captain Beidou was disappointed she didn't get to witness the crowning of the new champion. She had been looking forward to it for quite some time.

20021207.text: The one who stole the Vision was originally to be this hero's opponent in the final round.

20021208.text: He knew he stood no chance of winning the match, thus the wicked idea of stealing the prize took hold in his mind.

20021209.text: In which case, The Crux Clash comes to a clear-cut conclusion.

20021211.text: If that's the case, then the rules stipulate that he is disqualified... and our hero here is the champion!

20021212.text: Paimon thought we'd win and all, but not like this...

20021213.text: It doesn't matter, as the saying goes, "honor given is honor deserved." Now, let me go prepare the champion's medal to award you.

20021214.text: So will we be able to travel to Inazuma now?

20021215.text: Yes, I believe so. Though Captain Beidou is no longer present here, I'll be sure she receives word of it. She is a woman of her word.

20021216.text: But the voyage to Inazuma is a treacherous one. You will be plagued by a perpetual tempest the entire trip.

20021217.text: In fact, the relentless rain and wind are also an embodiment of the Raiden Shogun's will to close the nation.

20021218.text: Hold on a second, you're saying she can change the weather just with the power of her mind!?

20021219.text: Let us not forget that this is one of the Seven Archons. If Liyue's Morax could form Guyun Stone Forest by casting down his stone spears, then it should come as no great surprise that the Raiden Shogun is capable of summoning an eternal tempest.

20021220.text: Suffice it to say that if you wish to journey to Inazuma, the Alcor will need some time. You will be notified once all the preparations have been made.

20021221.text: In the meantime, I intend to embark on a journey of my own. I will travel all across the vast lands of Liyue, in the hope of finding a way to reawaken the Vision.

20021222.text: Paimon believes you'll find a way for sure!

20021223.text: Thank you. May both our journeys prove meaningful.

20021224.text: One final word of warning. The part of your journey that lies after the storm may well prove to be the most arduous.

20022401.text: I'll stay behind and explain the situation here. Just get the Vision back.

20022402.text: The spectators were all geared up to see an exciting match. I can't let them return disappointed.

20022901.text: There you have it, the evidence speaks for itself. It's no wonder Lady Ningguang was so concerned with the security of this area.

20022902.text: I doubt even Captain Beidou will manage to come out of all of this unscathed.

20023001.text: You're up! I wish you luck.

20023002.text: I await the results of this match with great anticipation.

20029902.text: The winds have come at an opportune moment. Let's seize this chance.

20029903.text: Ride the winds upward. From there, we can continue our search for clues.

20029904.text: By the way, what made you suddenly think of checking the prize in the first place?

20029905.text: I heard it the moment it was stolen.

20029906.text: Well then why didn't you stop him!?

413140101.text: Hello! Would you like to give Theater Mechanicus a go? It's loads of fun!

413140202.text: Certainly! You may start whenever you like.

413140302.text: Theater Mechanicus is a new kind of board game that I just invented.

413140303.text: All you need to play is a table, a few game pieces, and a game master.

413140304.text: The objective of the game is to use various strategies to withstand the monster attacks. At least, that's the main idea for now...

413140305.text: But who knows, if any more good ideas come to me, I'd like to expand the game's content even more.

413140306.text: It'd be great to add things like exploring ruins, or solving evil plots... If all goes well, the game could potentially become like a true adventure in another world.

413140401.text: How much does it cost to play?

413140402.text: Well, I've only just finished designing this board game and would like to hear what people think of such a game.

413140403.text: So, during the Lantern Rite, it won't cost anyone a single Mora to play. All you need is a Xiao Lantern and you can play one round.

413140404.text: If you'd like to give it a try, just let me know.

413140502.text: Farewell. If you'd like to give Theater Mechanicus a go, just let me know.

413140601.text: ...an epic fight. Legendary. The skies went black, there were howling winds and waves as high as houses. So the vile demon struck again, this time with all his might... but the adeptus just managed to dodge it! It was a powerful hit indeed; landed square on Mt. Tianheng! Boom!

413140603.text: How powerful was the hit? Try powerful enough to tear open the base of the mountain!

413140604.text: "A slight crack in the foundation; what's the big deal," you say? Well, let me tell you. Suddenly, there was a thunderous sound of giant rocks rolling down the mountains: The whole of Mt. Tianheng was on the verge of collapse! Meanwhile, down in the village, everyone stared up at the sight of impending doom and trembled with fear.

413140605.text: Skybracer knew that if he didn't act quickly, the entire village was going to be reduced to a pulp! Oh, the humanity...

413140607.text: This was it. It was now or never... Suddenly, the adeptus had a brainwave. "Aha! My antlers..."

413140608.text: Now. As we all know, the pair of antlers on Skybracer's head were a gift from the Lord of Geo. And what a magnificent gift they were: They were ten feet long and a hundred times harder than the hardest iron you can imagine...

413140609.text: That's when he summoned a fellow adeptus.

413140610.text: This masked companion was also a formidable fighter. He took a deep breath, and then with one almighty strike from his polearm he tore the antlers clean off the adeptus' head. Crash! They came tumbling to the ground...

413140611.text: Skybracer picked the antlers up off the floor. His own antlers. A piece of his very own body. And he thrust them into the foot of Mt. Tianheng! Guess what happened next?

413140612.text: It stopped the mountain from falling down — yes... but it also raised the mountain to thousands of feet higher than it had stood before!

413140623.text: How powerful was the hit? I'll tell you...

413140701.text: Hello, how may I help you?

413140703.text: Xiao Lantern-making is a traditional craft form at Lantern Rite. It's quite technical, you need to cut the paper, insert the wick, add wish sticks, paint it...

413140704.text: Sounds like quite an ordeal, huh? Fortunately, if you know how to use a Crafting Bench, it makes things much easier these days.

413140705.text: Hopefully, the gods don't think that cheapens the wishes we make.

413140706.text: The Crafting Bench is over there. Why not give it a try? The Lantern Rite only comes once a year.

413140708.text: May the flames of wisdom spread to all, and never be extinguished.

413140801.text: Ah, a customer! What can I get for you? How about some Lantern Rite specialties? We only make them once a year!

413140803.text: Certainly! Take a look and decide for yourself. I can do anything on the menu. Or if there's something in particular you're after, I can do that instead!

413140805.text: Haha, business is better than ever. Thanks for asking.

413140806.text: But if you ask me, making good food is what really counts. Perfecting tasty snacks is time well spent, rather than thinking all day about how to make more advertisements.

413140807.text: If it's good, it'll sell itself. At least, that's what I think. I don't need any boring advice from Wang'ya.

413150101.text: All this walking around working up your appetite? Why not curb your hunger with a freshly grilled Tiger Fish?

413150102.text: As it happens, this year's Mingxiao Lantern commemorates Skybracer; back in the day, grilled Tiger Fish was his favorite.

413150103.text: This year's Lantern Rite experience isn't complete until you've tried one!

413150201.text: I'd like to buy a snack.

413150202.text: You've come to the right place. We've got sizzling hot Grilled Tiger Fish.

413150301.text: Do you say that every year?

413150302.text: Haha... Yes, I do! I say the same thing every year, but I'm never lying.

413150303.text: It says so in the Historia Naturalis Liyue: a thousand years ago, all the adepti loved eating grilled Tiger Fish...

413150402.text: If you get peckish when you're browsing around Xiao Market, come and find me!

413150501.text: ...Mommy always used to take us to Xiao Market...

413150502.text: Yeah! Mommy would buy toys for us, take us to see the Xiao Lanterns... And she'd carry you when you got tired...

413150504.text: Yi Xian... Don't cry, let's make a Xiao Lantern for Mommy, shall we?

413150505.text: Huh? But I thought Xiao Lanterns were to remember the heroes who look after us...

413150506.text: You're right. Well, our mommy was a hero and she looked after us, didn't she?

413150507.text: So come on, wipe your tears away — let's welcome back Mommy's spirit and all the other heroes with big smiles on our faces!

413150601.text: Hi... Are you looking for me?

413150702.text: I'm Yi Zhu. You probably know my little sister, Yi Xian?

413150703.text: I promised Yi Xian that we would make a Xiao Lantern together for Mommy, but I couldn't gather the materials we needed. Thankfully, Changshun specially set aside some materials for us to use...

413150704.text: Everyone's been so good to me and my sister... *sniff*

413150706.text: *sniff* ...No, I can't cry... I can't let Yi Xian see me unhappy.

413150802.text: Goodbye... May the flames of wisdom spread to all, and never be extinguished.

413150901.text: Hi, I'm Linlang. I run an antiques shop called Xigu Antiques... How may I help you?

413151001.text: Please tell me about the Lantern Rite.

413151002.text: There's an abiding sense of nostalgia in the air during the Lantern Rite... Normally I only get that feeling in my shop; I love it, it makes me feel so at home.

413151003.text: Lantern Rite is much more ancient than any of the antiques in my shop, though.

413151004.text: Antiquity has real value. I should know, I make my living off that fact. So make the most of this very precious time of year.

413151102.text: Please enjoy this special time filled with the splendor of antiquity.

413151201.text: Hi! I'm the Manager of the Maritime Authority, and I'm in a fantastic mood right now!

413151202.text: Mmm, feel that sea breeze... Go on, close your eyes and just feel it for a second... Do you it feel it too?

413151204.text: No more fishing boats and cargo ships trying to get in and out of the harbor; no more application forms and approval forms... For a few days, I can forget all about it!

413151205.text: Praise be to the Lord of Geo!

413151301.text: I'm Changchang, I just donated Dolly. She's my ragdoll.

413151302.text: Last night in my dream, Dolly told me her wish was to fly up into the sky and see the view.

413151303.text: So I gave her to the lady over by the big deer lantern. Dolly's wish will come true now, won't it?

413151304.text: I did the right thing, didn't I? Wishes are supposed to come true at the Lantern Rite, aren't they?

413151401.text: May the flames of wisdom spread to all, and never be extinguished.

413151402.text: This is the Lantern Rite Gala, where everyone gathers for Lantern Rite. As one of the head planners for the event, is there anything I can assist with?

413151404.text: Lantern Rite is an annual festival everyone in Liyue celebrates. It takes place on the night of the first full moon of the year.

413151405.text: During the five-day festival, people pray for peace, ward off evil spirits, and watch the lanterns. We believe the fire's light keeps wisdom alive, and guides fallen heroes home along the sea.

413151406.text: It's a popular tradition to make the Mingxiao Lantern as well as smaller Xiao Lanterns and then release them into the night sky.

413151407.text: The lanterns light the path for the souls of our fallen heroes as they travel by cover of night. We hope the lanterns will guide them back home so they can be reunited with us here.

413151408.text: This is an extremely important festival, one which deserves meticulous preparation in every detail. It is my honor to be working as a planner.

413151409.text: Please be sure to visit the Xiao Market when you have the chance, that's where the most lively festivities can be found. I hope you thoroughly enjoy yourselves and participate in all the festivities on offer.

413151411.text: What would you like to know about? There's the Mingxiao Lantern, Xiao Market, as well as the Xiao Lanterns... I'd be happy to tell you all I know.

413151432.text: Okay. Well, enjoy your time here.

413151501.text: This year's Mingxiao Lantern is dedicated to Skybracer... He always was a show off — I'm sure he'll be very pleased!

413151602.text: This year's Mingxiao Lantern will be the spitting image of him when it's complete!

413151603.text: Well, that's the plan. I do hope they make the antlers big enough, they were his pride and joy after all.

413151604.text: The story goes that the antlers were made from the very essence of Rex Lapis' divine power, which made it the hardest material in all of Liyue.

413151605.text: But then, that fateful battle happened... The gods exchanged powerful blows, and the mountains started collapsing. To avoid impacting the villagers at the foot of the mountain, the adeptus got his friend to chop his antlers off...

413151606.text: He used those blood-drenched antlers as a wedge to prop up the mountain. And if that wasn't enough of a sacrifice, he then kept on fighting until his blood was drained and his life ran out...

413151607.text: Thanks to him, Mt. Tianheng still stands tall and proud to this day. And the blood that he lost in the battle turned into the Bishui River.

413151608.text: Hehehe... Whether you believe the story or not, I'm just happy that you're willing to hear me tell it.

413151609.text: Surely, the reason Lantern Rite exists is because people throughout the ages have chosen to come together as friends rather than stay in isolation.

413151702.text: Goodbye. May the flames of wisdom spread to all, and never be extinguished.

413151801.text: I'm Musheng, I come from out in the country. There's definitely more of a festive atmosphere in the city.

413151802.text: The heroes that we remember during Lantern Rite are actually adepti who lived in Liyue in the distant past.

413151803.text: That was a time when the adepti lived among the normal people. I don't know why we never see any adepti nowadays...

413151804.text: I can't help but think it's a bad omen... Ah, what am I saying? I shouldn't jinx the festival, should I? Haha.

413151901.text: H—Hello... Judging from your attire, we must be from the same place, no?

413151902.text: Hmm? Ah yes, hello. Sorry, I seldom meet other Snezhnayans around here.

413151903.text: The Lantern Rite sure is beautiful, isn't it?

413151904.text: Yes, but it seems that there's still much to come yet. The Mingxiao Lantern is the height of the festivities. At least, that's what I've heard.

413151905.text: Ah yes, so it seems. I've only just arrived here recently... I've come here alone, so there are still many things I don't quite understand yet.

413151906.text: Oh? I've also arrived recently myself, so I often come here alone to watch the ships sail in from Snezhnaya.

413151907.text: ...Though I know that these boats rolling in and out of the port are not the ones to take me back home. Huh, what a coincidence... I also often come and watch the boats here.

413151908.text: Are you sure we've never met before?

413151909.text: Could we have met before? Perhaps my memory is failing me... I apologize, it would be impolite if I've forgotten.

413151910.text: No, no, I'm sure we've never met. Though I feel that something is... awfully familiar when I'm speaking with you.

413151911.text: Ah, is that so... Well, that's perfectly alright...

413151912.text: The Lantern Rite... It sure is beautiful, isn't it?

413152001.text: This is my first time participating in the Lantern Rite. All in all, the atmosphere of the festivities is quite enjoyable.

413152002.text: What fascinates me most though is the Mingxiao Lantern... Who would've thought that the people of Liyue could build a lantern so big.

413152003.text: ...Watching the lighting and ascent of the Mingxiao Lantern must certainly be an unforgettable scene for everyone who participates in the Lantern Rite.

413152004.text: I'm really starting to enjoy this city... No, no, I must remain loyal to the Tsaritsa...

413152101.text: The glow of the Xiao Lanterns feels so warm...

413152102.text: Even as a stranger in this foreign city, seeing the brightly lit streets and Xiao Lanterns above in the night sky still brings some indescribable warmth to my heart.

413152103.text: Such a warm feeling reminds me of our "Krsnik Noc" in Snezhnaya.

413152104.text: If you ever have the chance, you must visit Snezhnaya and participate in one of our festivals.

413152201.text: Manager Kuan! I don't want a kite, I want a Xiao Lantern!

413152202.text: How many times do I have to tell you, just call me "Daddy."

413152203.text: If you want a Xiao Lantern, then we can just release one together. Now, if you want to write a wish on the lantern, just tell me and I'll...

413152204.text: No way! Your handwriting is terrible, Manager Kuan. If you write it, our wish will never come true!

413152205.text: Ah, child, how could you ever be so cold to your Daddy...

413152206.text: But aren't you the one who taught me to always be honest about what's on my mind?

413152207.text: And since I know that your handwriting is absolutely terrible, wouldn't I be disobeying if I told you it's fine for you to write?

413152208.text: *sigh* Fine, you're right... I'll buy you a lantern... But from now on, you must call me "Daddy."

413152209.text: Alright, "Daddy"! Now, Daddy! Do as you promised!

413152301.text: Hey, this is the big day! The annual Lantern Rite is finally here!

413152302.text: All of Liyue Harbor is already bustling with excitement around us. It's not often that you'll see the city in such a festive state.

413152303.text: ...But when it comes to Lantern Rite, the Mingxiao Lantern is the moment everyone's waiting for.

413152304.text: On the final of Lantern Rite, they'll release the Mingxiao Lantern, built by the efforts of all the people of Liyue, and the lantern will slowly ascend into the night sky. It'll be a moment you won't want to miss.

413152305.text: But I needn't say more. Take a walk around and take in all the festivities for yourself.

413152401.text: The glow of Xiao Lanterns fills the night sky, shedding light on lands below as they fly. The glow upon the sea dances before one's eyes, casting scattered lights as the waves arise...

413152402.text: Hmm, casting scattered lights? No, no... That's no good! Ah, now I've got it! "flickering endlessly on the tides of night."

413152403.text: Yes, yes, that's it! So, what do you think of my poem?

413152502.text: Hehe, I see you have good taste. My poems can set the mood even for an event as grand as the Lantern Rite.

413152503.text: *sigh* It's a shame that those who truly grasp the subtleties of verse and rhyme are few and far between.

413152504.text: I once posted my poems all around Liyue Harbor to help bring the spirit of Lantern Rite to the citizens of Liyue.

413152505.text: ...But before long, I was reported by the Millelith and was told that I would be arrested if I dared to post my poetry again.

413152506.text: Hmph, those uncultured curs, have they no taste at all!?

413152602.text: Just okay? Then you must certainly be missing the deep creativity and philosophical meaning behind the words!

413152701.text: Lantern Rite certainly is exciting. The lively atmosphere sure is different from the festivals that we have back in Mondstadt.

413152702.text: However, gourmets such as my brother and I do not revel in festivities and excitement. No, it is the delectable food and rare festival snacks we're after.

413152703.text: I heard that the special dish for this year's Lantern Rite is Grilled Tiger Fish, but after trying some myself, it seems like just ordinary Grilled Tiger Fish that you can get anytime.

413152704.text: Perhaps only locals can distinguish the subtle variation in flavor?

413152705.text: Oh, never mind. I'll just try some other snacks instead...

413152801.text: Looking for a hero? No... Looking for a mighty hero? I'm your guy.

413152902.text: That's right. Heroes are always commemorated at Lantern Rite.

413152903.text: Hmph, and one day I too shall become a hero that's revered by one and all, I'm certain of it!

413152904.text: Just you wait. By this time next year, crowds will be gathering to light lanterns for me, hehe...

413152905.text: But this is the festival for remembering fallen heroes.

413152906.text: Huh? You mean they don't commemorate you unless you're dead?

413152907.text: You're joking, right? I—I don't believe you!

413152908.text: W—Well then, never mind about next year's Lantern Rite...

413152909.text: In 50 years... No, in 100 years, everyone will remember this mighty hero during Lantern Rite!

413153002.text: Well then don't waste my time. I've got much to do yet on my journey to becoming a mighty hero.

413153101.text: While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail.

413153102.text: Have you released a Xiao Lantern yet? If you write a wish on the lantern, it's bound to come true someday.

413153103.text: For example, my wish was that my daughter Little Liu would live a peaceful and healthy life, and that she'd make many friends, haha.

413153104.text: ...Perhaps you'll even be able to see the sky filled with Xiao Lanterns from atop the hills of Qingce Village.

413153105.text: *sigh* Little Liu... Your daddy misses you so much...

413153201.text: For some reason, I feel that this year's Lantern Rite will be particularly magnificent.

413153202.text: I was originally planning to stock up on extra materials for making Xiao Lanterns and resell them for a profit during Lantern Rite.

413153203.text: But just as I was about to purchase the materials, I found out that Ningguang had instated laws against price gouging on Xiao Lantern materials.

413153204.text: If it weren't for Ningguang, I might have never realized what a shameful business scheme that was.

413153205.text: So given that I couldn't make any money on the materials anyway, I decided to just give my remaining Xiao Lantern materials to Yi Zhu and Yi Xian.

413153206.text: I hope that they will enjoy a lovely Lantern Rite this year.

413153302.text: Me? Oh, I'm trying to figure out how to set this thing up...

413153303.text: Which way were these lamps supposed to go... I can't remember...

413153401.text: I'd like to try the Illumiscreen.

413153402.text: ...Again? Sorry, you'll need to wait until I've got the new lanterns ready.

413153501.text: I'd like to try the Illumiscreen.

413153502.text: ...Again? Sorry, you'll need to wait until I've got the new lanterns ready.
